text: Vale drops the bomb: Sector Alpha's water has been glitching for three whole cycles, not just a fluke. Everyone splits up to investigate — Reed and Lumen keep the fountain calm, Flint drags his level to the sluice gate again, and now Reed switches sides too, joining Dusk's secret sunrise stakeout at Elsie's kelp farm to watch the water in silence. Meanwhile Flint catches Foreman Jerrick torching a whole pallet instead of following the rules, and files a complaint — a tiny move that might turn into a big problem for whoever's really in charge.
